borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Alterations to the existing rear roof extension and dormers at third floor to include an increase in height of parapet party wall, and new French doors with flanking sash windows, painted metal Juliet balustrade and new rooflight in flat roof; erection of a rear infill extension at ground floor level and installation of new Crittall-style doors to the kitchen and living room at ground floor to the rear; infilling of 1No rear facing window at ground floor level; new sash window to ground floor guest cloakroom; construction of new brick lift shaft at ground, first and second floors to the front and side elevation; relocation of front door at ground floor level with new projecting canopy above; installation of 3no. new sash windows in the side flank wall at first and second floor levels; modifications to the hardstanding outside kitchen doors at ground floor level and installation of a frameless glass balustrade.
